integrity: The paper is a self-contained mathematical argument checked by deterministic numerical cross-tests. No independent review has been performed; bibliographic completeness is not guaranteed.
scientific_limitations: Scalar exact skew-normal quantiles; one-step transport coupling compared against unshifted Brownian noise, not strong error against an exact SDE. Does not establish cost, strong convergence, or MLMC improvements. Classical monotone transport is not itself new.
title: Optimal one-Brownian skew-normal transport and the sharp Henze strong-error penalty
